cold_and_steady: Each CLI run starts cold; per-backend/shape/phase cold and steady observations, loading counters, and control contexts are in runs[].runtime_diagnostics. No extra warm-up samples are generated.

delivered_structure_parity.reason: workflow emitted no structure artifacts; model coordinate parity not measured

correctness.tolerance_source: maximum same-cell absolute deviation from the first direct repeat

experiment.scope: entire comparison loop, including between-trial analysis and failed work; per-mode GPU cost includes each trial's observation envelope

performance_claim: measured; inspect paired repetitions and backend coordinate parity

runs.cpu_cost_note: sampling can miss short-lived children; this is a lower bound
runs.gpu_activity_note: device-wide activity includes other jobs if allocation is not exclusive

process_release.scope: Observed PID/start-time identities, their descendants, and identity-anchored process groups only. Unobserved double forks or namespace escapes are not fully proved absent; complete arbitrary-program containment requires a job cgroup.
